notes.title: Carwyn Gets a Makeover in the New Femboy Update!
notes.notes:

And just look how cute he is![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906595/854c221c1062bd66a500cd1807aebdc1c3117ce0.png"][/img]  [/p][p]This update adds four variations of a new route in Netoria Tactics: Revolution Gold. notes.title: Bug Fix and Art Update
notes.notes:
Reworked all the party member sprites.
Fixed a bug that caused players to be forced onto the wrong endings.
Fixed a bug where Vivian could die before Carwyn rescued her and never join the party.
Fixed a bug where entering the grope chamber in the recollection room would result in a game over.
The Steam bonus items are now only usable on Normal and easier difficulties
